The monthly revenue bar chart is made and open on your screen. The image is at `/tmp/acme-chart/monthly_revenue.png`, outside the repo, so nothing in the repo changed.

Revenue rises from $41.2k in January to $71.8k in December. There are small dips in February, June and October. I labelled only the first and last bars to keep it clean.

- **December:** `data/sales.csv` already has a row for 2026-12, but today is 2026-11-28. That row is either a forecast or placeholder data, or it's wrong. I plotted it like the other months, so check whether it should be marked as projected or dropped.
- **Validator:** I didn't run the skill's palette validator. The chart is a single series in the reference blue, so the multi-color checks don't apply.
